tagline.en: A point-cloud 3D reconstruction and navigation model — recover geometry and camera poses, then render along a trajectory.
tagline.zh: 一个点云 3D 重建与导航模型——恢复几何与相机位姿,再沿轨迹渲染。

en: LoGeR, from Junyi42, is a 3D reconstruction model that works with point clouds. It recovers a scene's geometry and camera poses, and supports rendering along a chosen camera trajectory.
Its tasks span 3D reconstruction, trajectory rendering, and point-cloud output. From input imagery it produces camera poses, depth, and a dense point cloud that can be navigated.
In WorldFoundry it runs as a point-cloud navigation pipeline covering 3D reconstruction, trajectory, and point-cloud tasks, writing out poses, depth, and a PLY point-cloud artifact.
zh: LoGeR 由 Junyi42 开发,是一个基于点云的 3D 重建模型。它恢复场景的几何与相机位姿,并支持沿选定的相机轨迹渲染。
其任务涵盖 3D 重建、轨迹渲染与点云输出。它能从输入图像产出相机位姿、深度,以及一份可供导航的稠密点云。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以点云导航 pipeline 运行,覆盖 3D 重建、轨迹与点云任务,并输出位姿、深度和 PLY 点云结果。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to reconstruct a scene as a point cloud with camera poses and depth, and render or navigate the result along a trajectory.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把场景重建为带相机位姿与深度的点云,并沿轨迹渲染或导航结果时,使用它。

notFor.en: It is a reconstruction model, not a text- or image-to-video generator, and needs its checkpoint and a GPU to run.
notFor.zh: 它是重建模型,不是文/图生视频的生成器,并需要其 checkpoint 与 GPU 才能运行。

zh: 从输入图像进行点云 3D 重建
输出 PLY 点云结果
